title: HyCoInfer: Cloud-Edge Collaborative Inference for Large Language Models on Heterogeneous GPU-FPGA Architectures
abstract: arXiv:2611.22086v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) serving relies predominantly on cloud GPUs, yet autoregressive decoding is memory-bound and often leaves their arithmetic units underutilized. Edge FPGAs offer attractive decoding efficiency, but are ill suited to sustaining a high-concurrency serving workload alone. This paper presents HyCoInfer, a heterogeneous cloud-edge serving system that assigns prefill to cloud GPUs and distributes decoding across cloud GPUs and edge FPGAs. The design addresses three barriers to practical offloading: capacity balancing across heterogeneous accelerators, the large KV cache crossing a constrained wide-area link, and the latency added by heterogeneous execution. HyCoInfer incorporates FPGA decode capacity into GPU prefill/decode role partitioning and places requests according to queue load, prompt length, and network state. It further combines layer-wise pipelined transfer, decoder-side precomputation, and bandwidth-adapt

translated_title: HyCoInfer：基于异构GPU-FPGA架构的大语言模型云边协同推理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.22086v1 公告类型：交叉  摘要：大语言模型（LLM）服务主要依赖云端GPU，然而自回归解码过程受内存带宽限制，常常导致GPU的算术单元利用率不足。边缘FPGA虽具备有吸引力的解码效率，但难以独立支撑高并发的服务负载。本文提出HyCoInfer，一种异构云边服务系统，将预填充阶段分配给云端GPU，并将解码阶段分布到云端GPU与边缘FPGA上。该设计解决了实际卸载面临的三大障碍：异构加速器之间的容量均衡、跨越受限广域网链路传输大容量KV缓存、以及异构执行引入的额外延迟。HyCoInfer将FPGA的解码容量纳入GPU预填充/解码角色划分机制中，并根据队列负载、提示长度和网络状态来放置请求。此外，该系统结合了逐层流水线传输、解码端预计算以及带宽自适应……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: HyCoInfer提出了一种云边协同的异构GPU-FPGA大语言模型推理系统，通过将预填充分配给云端GPU、将解码任务分布到云端GPU与边缘FPGA，并解决异构容量均衡、KV缓存广域传输和异构执行延迟三大关键问题，实现高效的LLM服务。
en_tdlr: HyCoInfer is a heterogeneous cloud-edge serving system that assigns LLM prefill to cloud GPUs and distributes decoding across cloud GPUs and edge FPGAs, addressing capacity balancing across heterogeneous accelerators, large KV cache transfer over constrained WAN links, and heterogeneous execution latency.
